card.name: The verb keep before an action
card.fires_on: Forms of the verb "keep" (keep, keeps, kept) right after a subject, usually followed by an -ing verb or "on". Also fires weakly on "not" after "do" in disclaimers.

modes.label: Keep + continuing action
modes.description: The verb keep, keeps or kept after a subject, meaning something continues or repeats.
modes.example: That word "microbiome" — describing the collection of bacteria that live in and on our bodies —<< keeps>> popping up.

modes.label: Keep in mind / keep to
modes.description: Keep used with a place or idea to hold or stay.
modes.example: Those are the ideas you're going to<< keep>> in mind.

modes.label: Disclaimer "do not"
modes.description: The word "not" in a views-expressed disclaimer.
modes.example: The views expressed here do<< not>> necessarily represent those of NewsSource 1
